$comment: Machine-readable capability matrix for the LibertyNet developer portal. SINGLE SOURCE OF TRUTH for every 'Implemented / Testing / Planned' badge rendered in the docs, the SDKs and the dashboard. Never hand-edit a badge in an .mdx file — edit this file and re-run `node tools/check-docs-drift.mjs`.
verified_against: https://registry.libertynet.ai (live probe) + https://libertynet.ai/demo-node (end-to-end loop), see TEST-EVIDENCE.md

levels.implemented: Live on a public endpoint today. Anyone can call it right now and get a real answer.
levels.testing: Code exists and its own test suite passes, but it is NOT reachable on a public endpoint yet.
levels.planned: Designed, not built. There is no code behind this. Do not build against it yet.
levels.not_yet_wired: The endpoint IS live and returns 200, but its data source is not connected, so it honestly returns zeros/empties plus "source": "not_yet_wired". Reading it is safe; believing the numbers is not.

groups.title: Canonical demo node
groups.note: A real, publicly reachable LibertyNet node run by the project so the quickstart's discover -> verify -> act loop is true for people outside it. It registers, signs and heartbeats through the same public endpoints any node uses, and deliberately holds nothing of value.

endpoints.note: Liveness, registration state, capabilities.
DID, public key (base58 and hex), fingerprint.
Signs a caller-supplied nonce, so the reply is proof of possession rather than a replayable recording.
The three verification steps, as data.

groups.title: Community
groups.note: Not an API surface, tracked here so its status is derived from the same single source as everything else rather than asserted by hand in prose.

endpoints.note: The Discord server does not exist yet — creating one needs an interactive login. The address is reserved and referenced in the docs so that it can be swapped in one command (community/apply-invite.mjs) the moment it is real. Until then every reference to it is badged `planned`.
Issues, pull requests and the source for everything documented here.
